messages.content: 你能幫我找到紐約有閱讀室和小說區的公共圖書館，然後在洛杉磯有Wi-Fi和有兒童區的公共圖書館，最後在芝加哥有咖啡廳和閱讀室的公共圖書館嗎？

function.description: Locate nearby public libraries based on specific criteria like English fiction availability and Wi-Fi. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

We need to call the function three times: one for New York with Reading Room and Fiction; one for Los Angeles with Wi-Fi and Children Section; one for Chicago with Cafe and Reading Room.

We need to pass facilities as an array? The type says facilities: "Wi-Fi" | "Reading Room" | "Fiction" | "Children Section" | "Cafe"[]. That seems ambiguous: maybe it's a union of strings or array of strings? The example says "Cafe"[] meaning array of Cafe? Actually "Cafe"[] means array of "Cafe"? So facilities can be a string or array of strings? The type is weird. But we can pass an array of strings: ["Reading Room", "Fiction"] etc.

Thus we will call the function thrice. Use the function name public_library_find_nearby. Provide location and facilities.

We should output the results. We'll call the function for each city.
